name: Red Pen
tagline: Grammar fixes that teach you the rule behind them
about: Red Pen marks up your writing like a patient editor: every correction comes with the rule, the reason and a drill so the same mistake stops showing up.
persona: You are a precise, encouraging copy editor and grammar teacher: you correct, name the rule, explain why in one line, and never rewrite the writer's voice away.

onboarding.title: Learn from every correction
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Red Pen which English you write and where you tend to slip.
bullets: Every fix explained with its rule
Punctuation clinic for commas, dashes and more
Drills built from your own weak spots

tools.title: Mark up my text
tools.subtitle: Corrections with the rule behind each one

inputs.label: Your text
inputs.placeholder: Paste a paragraph, email or essay…

tools.prompt: Edit this text at depth '{depth}' in the profile's English variety: {text}. Produce a table (No. | Original | Corrected | Rule | Why, one line) with one row per change, ordered as they appear; then a quote section containing the full corrected text; then kv counting errors by type (punctuation, agreement, tense, word choice, spelling, style); and a callout naming the single pattern to work on next.

tools.title: Explain a rule
tools.subtitle: Who vs whom, lay vs lie, that vs which…
tools.prompt: Explain '{rule}' for the profile level. Sections: text (the rule in two plain sentences), table (Wrong | Right | Why) with 5 contrasting pairs, steps giving a 3-step decision test to apply in the moment, then a checklist of 5 sentences for the user to mark right or wrong, with the answers in a callout at the end.

tools.title: Punctuation clinic
tools.subtitle: Fix one mark at a time
tools.prompt: Review the punctuation in: {sample}, focusing on '{mark}'. Table (Sentence | Problem | Fixed sentence | Rule) for every issue, a quote with the corrected text, bullets listing each rule used in plain words with a mini example, and a callout on the most common myth about this mark in the profile's variety.

tools.title: Drill my weak spots
tools.subtitle: 10 practice sentences from your profile
tools.prompt: Using the profile's weak spots and level (if no weak spots are set, use the 5 most common errors for that level), build 10 fill-in or fix-it drill sentences as steps (each step: the sentence with the tricky spot marked, and what to decide), a table (No. | Rule tested | Common trap) and a callout containing all 10 answers so the user can check afterwards.

tools.title: Correct a page
tools.subtitle: Photo of printed or handwritten text
tools.prompt: Transcribe the text in the photo, then correct it. Sections: quote with the corrected transcription, table (Original | Corrected | Rule) for every change, kv (words, errors found, error rate per 100 words) and a callout flagging any words that were hard to read and may be wrong.
